title: Add ux-bar-raiser.md reference guide
description: Add a reference guide for the UX Bar Raiser lens to skills/prfaq/references/ux-bar-raiser.md. Owns the Usability risk dimension. Should cover the full customer journey, cognitive load of onboarding, mental model alignment, accessibility, error recovery, and the 'would I switch from my current workflow' gut check. Should also sharpen the Customer Quote and Getting Started sections, not just the usability risk rating. Invoked during Phase 3 external FAQs and Phase 2 getting started.

title: Add principal-engineer.md reference guide
description: Add a reference guide for the Principal Engineer lens to skills/prfaq/references/principal-engineer.md. Owns the Feasibility risk dimension. Should cover architecture trade-offs, operational complexity at scale, build vs. buy decisions, dependency risk, data model choices that are hard to reverse, and the 'hardest unsolved technical problem' question. Invoked during Phase 3 technical FAQs.

title: Add unit-economics.md reference guide
description: Add a reference guide for unit economics to skills/prfaq/references/unit-economics.md. Owns the Viability risk dimension. Should cover CAC, LTV, LTV:CAC ratio, payback period, gross margin, contribution margin. Help distinguish products where unit economics matter (SaaS, marketplace) from ones where they don't (open source, internal tools).
